title: LLM Model Sizes Over Time
description: Parameter counts for major language models from 2019 to 2026. Log scale. Dashed circles = estimated, double rings = not yet released.
caveat: No frontier lab has disclosed official parameter counts since GPT-3. All values for 2023+ models are community estimates from leaks, benchmark analysis, and scaling projections.

fields.name: Model name
fields.estimated: Whether parameter count is estimated (vs. officially disclosed)
fields.unreleased: Whether model is not yet publicly available
